messages:
eva: Running into a weird instability after we enabled act-quant + AWQ group-size=96 on the canary. Small fraction of requests returning repetitive / collapsed tokens near the end of long contexts. anyone seen this?
samir: Ugh. Is it deterministic? do you have an example prompt + response?
eva: repro prompt attached in evalsuite; failure rate ~0.8% on longchat-50k set, mostly >1024 tokens. Short contexts fine.
jonah: Could be KV cache alignment issue when groups don't divide sequence len nicely. We had a similar symptom with dynamic batching before.
li: Do you see any decode errors in the runtime logs? OOMs or "invalid kv index"?
eva: No OOM. Runtime logs show repeated get_kv entries then identical logits for multiple steps. snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T10:12:01Z] INFO serve: decode step 1023 -> logits repeated for steps 1024-1027
[2026-03-19T10:12:01Z] DEBUG awq: group=96 act_q=4 packed_kv_offset=24576
```
grace: act_q=4 meaning 4-bit activation quant? are we using per-channel or per-tensor quant?
eva: per-channel for weights, activation quant currently per-tensor because that's what the AWQ pipeline produced. Changing to per-channel activations is non-trivial right now.
samir: Try reducing group-size to 64 in canary to see if reproduces. Also toggle act-quant granularity flag to `use_per_channel_act=false`/true.
eva: did a quick canary set: 2000 requests with group=64 -> failure rate dropped to 0.12%. group=32 -> 0.05%.
jonah: That strongly suggests group boundary interaction. When group doesn't align with the cached KV blocks, we might be reusing stale packed activations for subsequent tokens.
bench-bot: evalsuite results uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/awq/group-sensitivity/1912345678/report.csv (ppl delta, exact-match)
li: Another angle: are we applying activation quantization before or after rematerialized attention layers? ordering bug could quantize wrong tensor shape. check model compile logs.
eva: model compile shows act-quant pass applied after fwd-attn rewrite. I'll try to re-run with act-quant earlier in graph.
grace: For immediate mitigation, canary rollback to group=32 and schedule a focused kernel/compile audit. Also open a runtime ticket so oncall can add extra KV cache assertions. I'll create an incident.
deploy-bot: Canary update: model:open-awq:v2 -> settings changed {"group_size":32} at 1912345890 by grace.
eva: After rollback to 32, no recurrences in next 5k requests. I'll run a more exhaustive sweep: group=[16,32,48,64,96], act_q=[3,4,6], per_channel_act=[true,false], report back.
samir: nice. capture stack traces and add a deterministic fuzz harness generating misaligned lengths. if we can reproduce locally we can avoid reverting in prod often.
eva: ack. uploading fuzz harness and initial logs to the thread. planning to push a patch to the AWQ compiler to handle non-divisible group tails. will post PR once ready.
